source.snippet: How can I ban the user named Copilot from being able to access or make contributions to our GitHub repository? Our repo has a policy explicitly forbidding content generated from AI. The 'Block user' option is missing for 'Copilot'.

problem_statement: Repository owners and open-source maintainers who have explicit no-AI-generated-content policies have no platform-level controls to prevent AI bots (e.g., GitHub Copilot) from participating in code reviews or PR discussions, undermining their governance policies.
target_segment: Open-source maintainers and enterprise repo owners on GitHub with AI-content policies
notes: Niche but growing as more orgs adopt AI-content policies (legal, licensing, or cultural reasons). A browser extension or GitHub App that enforces AI-bot exclusion rules could fill this gap.
